name: mcp-nest-examples-e2e
description: End-to-end tests that boot each example server as a real subprocess and drive it with TWO clients: a pinned, intentionally-OLD one (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.10.0 — the floor of @rekog/mcp-nest's supported peer range) and a modern one (@modelcontextprotocol/client, protocol revision 2026-07-28). The old client catches server/SDK changes that would break clients already in the wild; the modern client guards the 2026-era leg. They are separate packages, so the old one stays pinned no matter what the modern one moves to. Not part of the npm workspace on purpose.
